title: Recording: Mary Had A Little Lamb by Wings | 1972
content:
Studio One, Olympic Studios, London
Producer: Glyn Johns
Engineers: Phil Chapman

Wings began recording their second single ‘Mary Had A Little Lamb’ on 27 March 1972.

The song was taped during the sessions for their second album Red Rose Speedway, but was issued as a standalone single in May 1972.

The music was recorded over three consecutive days at Olympic Studios in Barnes, London. The choice of song caused some dismay among the group.

I didn’t understand it. Henry and I, the two rebels in the band, we said, ‘I thought we wanted to become a rock-and-roll band; what the hell is this ‘Mary Had A Little Lamb’ s**t?’
Denny Seiwell, 9 June 2016
The McCartney Legacy: Volume 1: 1969-73, Allan Kozinn, Adrian Sinclair

The backing track featured Paul McCartney and Denny Laine on pianos, Henry McCullough on electric guitar, and Denny Seiwell on drums.
